days.regime_label: 市场价格代理（非原编辑判断） · risk_off

catalysts.title: September minutes retain a further-hike bias and discuss market function
catalysts.evidence: Released October 7 at 14:00EDT, the minutes show most participants expected another hike by year end to be appropriate. A few also called for preparation against possible Treasury-market dysfunction.
catalysts.transmission: 政策路径/期限溢价→融资与估值；市场功能讨论不是救市承诺。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
catalysts.confirmation: Later policy communication and inflation evidence remain consistent with a further-hike assessment.
catalysts.invalidation: New labor or inflation data change the risk balance, or officials explicitly distinguish current policy from theSeptember assessment.

catalysts.title: IEA accelerates existing emergency-stock commitments and prioritizes diesel
catalysts.evidence: IEA members supported faster completion of theMarch 2026 stock action and prioritizing diesel. About 100 million barrels remained pledged but unreleased; this was not a newly announced 100 million-barrel commitment.
catalysts.transmission: 实际投放→柴油紧张缓和→成本与通胀。 European diesel is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
catalysts.confirmation: Published implementation figures demonstrate faster releases and improved product availability.
catalysts.invalidation: Operational delays or larger new disruptions absorb the buffer before it reduces physical-market tightness.

catalysts.title: Applied Digital highlights rapid growth and a large accounting bridge
catalysts.evidence: Applied Digital reported FY2027Q1 revenue of $341.9 million, GAAP loss per share$0.76 and adjusted loss per share$0.01. GAAP includes ChronoScale, while presented non-GAAP measures exclude it.
catalysts.transmission: AI建设收入→现金转化/融资需求→估值质量。 APLD is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
catalysts.confirmation: Recurring rental revenue, cash conversion and funded capital spending validate sustainable expansion.
catalysts.invalidation: Construction revenue or consolidation adjustments mask continued cash losses or funding dependence.

growth.formula: S&P 500 1D direction; equity-demand proxy, NOT GDP

inflation.formula: Brent same-basis 1D direction; energy-price proxy, NOT CPI

earnings.formula: Nasdaq 1D minus S&P 500 1D; growth-style relative return, NOT EPS revisions

liquidity.formula: Negative dollar-index 1D direction; financial-conditions proxy, NOT fund flow

geopolitics.formula: VIX 1D direction; market risk-premium proxy, NOT proof of geopolitical events

price_proxy.regime_formula: SPX up + VIX down → risk_on; SPX down + VIX up → risk_off; both unchanged → neutral; conflicting observed directions → event_risk. Missing required data stays unclassified.
price_proxy.note: 市场价格代理，不是恢复出的当日编辑判断：增长/盈利/流动性/地缘行分别使用权益、相对收益、美元和VIX代理，不冒充GDP、EPS修正、资金流或真实事件。只使用原补档中有来源的截点前行情。

days.regime_label: Event Risk / Oil–Duration and AI Funding

catalysts.title: Oct 8 oil settlement spike gives way to Friday Asia relief while Saudi and Hormuz risks remain unresolved
catalysts.evidence: Brent settled at $104.28/bbl (+4.1%) and WTI at $91.49 (+3.6%) on October 8 after supply concerns and Gulf storm shut-ins. On Friday Asia reporting, Brent had eased around $102.91 as US-Iran diplomacy commentary changed the near-term risk premium.
catalysts.transmission: Gulf disruption / storm output → crude and freight → inflation expectations → Treasury yields → long-duration equity valuations.
catalysts.confirmation: Brent stabilizing below the Thursday settlement with verified shipping improvements and lower traded Treasury yields would support a genuine moderation.
catalysts.invalidation: Renewed verified attacks or prolonged Gulf shut-ins alongside sustained crude reacceleration would invalidate the relief trade.

catalysts.title: Oct 8 Nasdaq falls 1.25% as AI funding scrutiny overpowers broader Wall Street resilience
catalysts.evidence: Nasdaq Composite closed at 27,193.34 (-1.25%) against S&P 500 -0.47% and Dow +0.10%; financial press debated the revenue-to-capex bridge of AI infrastructure, while the report itself did not establish audited revenue for all involved firms.
catalysts.transmission: Capital intensity / unverified revenue projections → financing costs → equity discount rates → tech leadership breadth and credit risk.
catalysts.confirmation: Improved semiconductor breadth and independently reported funded AI contracts with stable Treasury yields would confirm a temporary rotation.
catalysts.invalidation: New bond spreads or broad Nasdaq drawdown with persistently high long yields and weak AI cash conversion would undermine the stabilization case.

catalysts.title: US $22bn 30-year Treasury auction stops at 5.618% with 2.54 bid-cover and 72.3% indirect allocation
catalysts.evidence: The October 8 Treasury auction priced $22bn of 30-year securities at 5.618%, with a 2.54 bid-to-cover ratio and indirect bidders taking 72.3%; traded 10-year yield retreated to around 5.227% afterward, distinct from H.15 10Y constant maturity of 5.28%.
catalysts.transmission: Auction absorption → traded long-end yield relief → lower discount-rate impulse; persistent inflation and issuance still constrain the medium-term yield floor.
catalysts.confirmation: Traded 10Y and 30Y yields staying lower on fresh issuance and tighter funding spreads would validate follow-through.
catalysts.invalidation: Renewed long-end selloff despite similar auction demand or upward inflation expectations would invalidate the relief interpretation.

days.regime_label: Event Risk / Oil–Inflation Expectations and Duration

catalysts.title: Oct 9 oil settlement $104.72: Gulf hurricane shut-ins withstand Iran diplomacy relief
catalysts.evidence: Brent December ended at $104.72 (+0.42%) and WTI November at $91.85 (+0.39%) on Oct9 after early declines; Gulf offshore crude production shutdowns surpassed 70% as Hurricane Isaias approached.
catalysts.transmission: Physical Gulf outage and shipping → oil/refined fuel premiums → household inflation expectations → bond yields → risk equity multiples.
catalysts.confirmation: Verified restoration in U.S. Gulf offshore production and shipping with sustained lower Brent and Treasury yields confirms real easing.
catalysts.invalidation: Fresh audited Gulf outage extension, verified shipping attacks or oil-price reacceleration rejects near-term supply normalization.

catalysts.title: Oct 9 Michigan confidence 46.3 with one-year inflation expectations 4.7%
catalysts.evidence: The University of Michigan October preliminary sentiment index fell to 46.3 from September 48.1; current conditions were 44.7 while one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.7% and five-year to 3.5%.
catalysts.transmission: Energy/real income stress → worse sentiment plus higher expected CPI → uncertainty in Fed reaction → rates and credit/tech multiples.
catalysts.confirmation: Follow-up inflation/consumption prints and matched US Treasury yields can show whether weaker demand outweighs price expectations.
catalysts.invalidation: New surveys contradict rising inflation expectations and reveal clear disinflation despite energy pressure.

catalysts.title: Oct 9 Delta cuts adjusted FY2026 EPS guidance to $5.10–$5.60 despite growing revenue
catalysts.evidence: Delta reported September-quarter GAAP revenue $20.2bn, adjusted revenue $17.6bn and adjusted EPS $1.72; FY adjusted EPS was cut to $5.10–$5.60 versus prior $6.50–$7.50 in the high fuel-cost environment.
catalysts.transmission: Jet fuel↑ → airline adjusted margins and free cash flow↓ → EPS revisions↓ → cyclical consumer and credit risk premium↑.
catalysts.confirmation: Documented jet fuel retreat together with improved airline cash flow and maintained travel yields confirms recovery.
catalysts.invalidation: Another issuer profit downgrade, higher fuel, or worsening quarterly cash conversion invalidates margin resilience.

catalysts.title: Oct 10–11 Saudi airport strikes renew aviation and regional transit risk before Oct 12 oil trading
catalysts.evidence: Reuters and AP reported deadly Houthi attacks and a repeat strike at Riyadh international airport, at least 12 reported dead in the initial attack and hundreds hurt; airline operations were disrupted. Verified Saudi oilfield production loss from these airport strikes has not been established.
catalysts.transmission: Airport strikes and regional confrontation → airline routing/insurance and tanker risk premiums↑ → transport fuel costs and expected inflation↑ → discount-rate / airline margins pressure.
catalysts.confirmation: Documented airport reopening, reduced regional security incidents and verified lower matched Brent quotes would confirm physical-risk normalization.
catalysts.invalidation: Fresh verified transport attacks, durable flight closures or proven new supply interruption would invalidate a quick normalization narrative.

catalysts.title: Oct 12 Monday equities and FX trade against a SIFMA-recommended U.S. cash-bond holiday
catalysts.evidence: Reuters Monday Asia snapshot indicated S&P500 futures near +0.2%, Nasdaq futures near +0.5% and DXY about 102.14, while SIFMA recommends U.S. fixed-income cash market closure for Columbus Day and Japan cash equities also observe Sports Day.
catalysts.transmission: Holiday calendar and reduced liquidity → thinner cross-asset confirmation → futures/equity volatility → Tuesday UST cash reopen tests term premium → equity duration repricing.
catalysts.confirmation: Tuesday actual cash Treasury reopening with same-basis lower 10Y yields and Monday broad stock participation confirms duration relief.
catalysts.invalidation: Tuesday matched cash UST yields return higher while Monday only megacaps advanced, rejecting a broad sustainable risk-on signal.

catalysts.title: Oct 13 bank earnings and Oct 14 U.S. September CPI test duration and earnings simultaneously
catalysts.evidence: Issuer investor-relations calendars confirm JPMorgan Chase Q3 results on October 13 around 07:00 EDT and Citigroup around 08:00 EDT. U.S. BLS schedules September CPI for October 14 at 08:30 EDT; neither upcoming result is released at this research cutoff.
catalysts.transmission: Bank credit/funding margins and CPI surprise → policy/UST rate path → bank credit supply and equity multiples → S&P500/Russell sector breadth.
catalysts.confirmation: CPI undercuts price pressure while bank releases show resilient real credit quality and matched Treasury yields ease.
catalysts.invalidation: CPI upside surprise together with weaker bank loan-loss trends and renewed yield pressure rejects the favorable base case.

catalysts.title: October 13 Asia risk-off reprices Korean and Japanese technology exposure after the October 12 U.S. chip decline
catalysts.evidence: Reuters' early October 13 Asian wrap reports MSCI Asia Pacific ex-Japan around -2%, KOSPI around -6% and Nikkei around -2.6%, while the October 12 U.S. Nasdaq fell 0.44%. These are intraday Asian readings, not an Asia cash close.

catalysts.confirmation: Check Tuesday full-session KOSPI/Nikkei closes, semiconductor breadth and USD/JPY versus matched UST yields; continued broad declines confirm transmission.

catalysts.title: October 12 Brent closes at $106.65 as OPEC trims 2026 demand forecast and Saudi pipeline capacity remains a future plan

catalysts.invalidation: Documented new shipping incidents, stable high prices despite forecast cuts, or project delays negate the near-term offset hypothesis.

catalysts.evidence: Issuer calendars place JPMorgan and Citi's September-quarter earnings on October 13 U.S. premarket, while BLS places September CPI on October 14 at 08:30 EDT. At today's 10:30 SGT cut, bank results and the CPI actual are both pending.

catalysts.invalidation: PMI继续回落并伴随出口数量/利润率疲软；进口能源成本↑、订单扩张放缓→制造业利润率↓→亚洲股市与地区利率路径差异。

catalysts.title: 11月2日美国ISM、11月3日JOLTS与本周AI财报将检验科技估值和宏观折现率
catalysts.evidence: 10月30日纳指跌2.86%后，本周苹果、AMD、Palantir财报受关注；ISM当日尚未公布，JOLTS与11月6日就业报告排期可由BLS核对。
catalysts.transmission: ISM订单/价格→增长与通胀预期→美债期限利率；AI财报现金回款→股权估值与借款利差。
catalysts.confirmation: 正式ISM和企业财报同时支持盈利韧性且实际现金流改善
catalysts.invalidation: 价格指标再加速或财报自由现金流指引恶化；ISM订单/价格→增长与通胀预期→美债期限利率；AI财报现金回款→股权估值与借款利差。

days.regime_label: Oil Relief / AI ROI Repricing / US Macro Resilience

catalysts.title: 11月2日Brent结算暴跌7.6%但美股纳指仍跌1.07%：地缘缓和预期与AI折价分离
catalysts.evidence: Reuters和Financial Times确认11月2日Brent期货跌7.6%收104.77美元，WTI跌7.4%收96.46美元；美股当日标普收跌0.51%，纳指跌1.07%，道指则升0.41%。卡塔尔调停仍停留在外交草案阶段，未证实霍尔木兹海运恢复。
catalysts.transmission: 谈判预期→原油风险溢价回落→通胀/久期压力下降；AI自由现金流疑虑→纳指估值与信用受压。
catalysts.confirmation: 核对11月3日实物流量、航运保费与同期限Brent继续回落，同时观察纳指广度及高收益融资价差是否稳定。
catalysts.invalidation: 若草案谈判受挫、航道持续受阻导致油价迅速反弹，或AI企业资本回报在公司级现金流证据下显著改善。

catalysts.title: 11月2日Apple与Palantir强劲财报仍未消除AI资金回报和成本风险
catalysts.evidence: Apple披露当季总营收约1144.8亿美元、EPS 2.10美元，下一财季毛利率预计降至45%–46%；Palantir披露Q3营收23.1亿美元同比增长约96%，并将Q4收入展望指向26.49亿–26.53亿美元。两家公司需求强，但持续资本效率、利润率与客户合同期限仍有可验证不确定性。
catalysts.transmission: 收入确认→营收预期改善，但成本/折旧/资本投入上升→现金转换率变化→估值和信用融资差异扩大。
catalysts.confirmation: 复核正式财报收入、毛利率、经营现金流、指引与盘后交易量，比较供应链及融资密集型标的的次日开盘表现。
catalysts.invalidation: 如果公司正式现金流和完整指引证明此前成本担忧过度，且广泛AI板块信用利差收敛，盈利分化观点应降权。

catalysts.title: 11月2日ISM制造业55.5确认扩张，11月3日JOLTS与AMD财报仍待公布
catalysts.evidence: 美国ISM官方于11月2日公布10月制造业PMI55.5（上月54.5）、新订单55.5、价格75.2（上月77.9）。11月3日即将发布的JOLTS为美国劳动力需求的下一项可验证读数，AMD则计划美股盘后公布Q3结果；上述未来事件在本次截止时间均无结果。
catalysts.transmission: 订单及成本数据→联储政策预期→美元/2Y与10Y收益率；AMD财报→AI供应链盈利质量和科技指数。
catalysts.confirmation: 按官方时刻核验JOLTS职位空缺及裁员分项，AMD报告后再核对营收指引、订单及资本成本，不能用事前共识补成实际值。
catalysts.invalidation: 若JOLTS数据与市场路径无显著对应，或AMD指引与跨供应商现货需求冲突，必须降低事件驱动解释权重。

days.regime_label: Selective AI Recovery / Rates Repricing / Oil Risk / Election Counting

catalysts.title: AMD公布Q3数据中心收入同比+97%及Q4收入约170亿美元指引：AI算力强需求获新证据
catalysts.evidence: 11月3日16:15 EST AMD正式披露Q3收入133.77亿美元、调整后EPS2.09美元，数据中心业务同比增长约97%，并指引Q4收入约170亿美元。
catalysts.transmission: 算力订单→芯片供应链收入与毛利→估值改善；融资成本→终端回本期→可持续需求。
catalysts.confirmation: 对比Q4约170亿美元收入指引、55%非GAAP毛利率与存货、客户部署节奏；观察次日美股半导体广度。
catalysts.invalidation: 若客户延后采购、毛利或营运现金流较指引显著恶化，订单验证结论下降。

catalysts.title: 美国9月JOLTS职位空缺752.3万、裁员164.1万：利率高位压力压制久期
catalysts.evidence: 官方BLS确认9月岗位空缺752.3万、8月修订719万、辞职336.5万、裁员164.1万；Cboe ^TNX 4.948%。
catalysts.transmission: 劳动需求→政策利率预期→美元与美债2Y/10Y→科技估值与企业融资成本。
catalysts.confirmation: 核对11月4日ADP与ISM服务业，再对照美10Y和美元的同时间窗路径；等待11月6日就业报告。
catalysts.invalidation: 若后续工资与服务通胀放缓、就业需求转弱则利率上行压力消退。

catalysts.title: 11月3日美股AI反弹但多数成分股仍跌、Brent进一步回落；中期选举尚在计票
catalysts.evidence: 标普+0.36%、纳指+0.83%而道指-0.38%；Brent 103.60美元，AP已确认部分席位但未确认最终国会控制权。
catalysts.transmission: 能源风险溢价→通胀/债券；选举→财政与AI监管预期→股票行业估值。
catalysts.confirmation: 观察AP后续正式席位判定和油轮运量、航运保险费，验证权益反弹是否伴随信用利差下降。
catalysts.invalidation: 若正式外交协议落地、广度显著改善或出现能源供给再次中断，当前混合框架须重估。

days.regime_label: Election Relief / Oil Risk Premium Compression / AI Balance-Sheet Split

catalysts.title: 美国中期选举确认民主党取得两院控制权后，11月4日美股广泛反弹但AI算力基建分化
catalysts.evidence: Reuters确认民主党在11月3日中期选举后取得众议院和参议院控制权；11月4日标普500收于7,688.62升约1.6%、道指涨约3%，但费城半导体指数跌约3.1%。
catalysts.transmission: 选举结果清晰→不确定性贴水下降→大盘与长久期板块获支持；AI政策风险与资金成本→数据中心资本强度分化。
catalysts.confirmation: 持续观察半导体指数相对Nasdaq的表现、数据中心债利差和大盘上涨家数，确认反弹是否扩散至融资依赖行业。
catalysts.invalidation: 如议会政策实际走向推高新监管成本、长期利率快速反弹或AI算力融资恶化，宽泛反弹可能回吐。

catalysts.title: 11月4日Brent单日跌8.7%至94.62美元，油价交易伊朗外交缓和预期而非实际达成和平协议
catalysts.evidence: Reuters记录11月4日布伦特结算94.62美元每桶、WTI结算88.12美元每桶，单日分别下降8.7%与8.3%；报道明确油市押注外交缓和，并未证实和平安排与海湾航运恢复。
catalysts.transmission: 油价→能源输入型成本及通胀预期→名义收益率→高久期资产及航空消费利润率。
catalysts.confirmation: 核对后续实际出口量、航运保险/过境证据及油价连续结算与近远月价差，区分政策标题与实际供给恢复。
catalysts.invalidation: 若霍尔木兹实际航线风险持续或冲突再升级，能源风险溢价可能在没有协议约束的情况下迅速回升。

catalysts.title: 美国10月ISM服务业54.5且支付价格73.0与高通FYQ4营收同比下降8%形成增长和行业盈利分化
catalysts.evidence: ISM原始发布服务业PMI54.5、新订单55.9、价格73.0；高通SEC披露FY2026第四季GAAP营收103.22亿美元同比下降8%、手机业务下降26%、汽车业务增长89%。
catalysts.transmission: 服务价格→联储宽松路径→收益率；手机与汽车业务组合→芯片收入与毛利→AI数据中心订单目标兑现风险。
catalysts.confirmation: 对照11月6日BLS非农与未来服务业价格报告，并核验高通下一季指引的实际达成及现金流表现。
catalysts.invalidation: 若正式非农与后续价格数据出现同步快速放缓，或新订单/盈利预测显著上调，则当前“价格粘性+盈利分化”判断需修正。

days.regime_label: AI Permitting & Cash-Flow Repricing / Gulf Freight Risk / Bond Flight-to-Safety

catalysts.title: AI数据中心许可和资本开支担忧触发11月5日美股与半导体极端下跌
catalysts.evidence: 纳指收24,315.00跌5.52%，SOX收9,011.14跌12.25%，Nvidia跌9.26%；Reuters报道中期选举后地方与新国会对新数据中心建设审查的预期上升。
catalysts.transmission: 地方许可政策预期→工期及资本开支推迟→GPU/存储采购规模下修→SOX和数据中心信用估值承压。
catalysts.confirmation: 检查后续数据中心许可政策正式文本与SOX/信用同步是否继续恶化，而非仅依据市场传闻。
catalysts.invalidation: 若没有新许可限制落地、设备订单和项目融资继续稳定，而SOX出现持续相对修复，则单日暴跌或主要来自拥挤仓位。

catalysts.title: 11月5日海湾油轮事件令Brent从前一日暴跌后反弹近4%
catalysts.evidence: Reuters11月5日报道多起船舶事件、Brent结算98.29美元上涨3.88%，WTI结算90.52美元上涨2.72%；此前11月4日油价因外交缓和预期大幅下跌。
catalysts.transmission: 船舶袭击→运力与保险风险上升→能源涨价→通胀预期上升→利率和航空/化工企业利润承压。
catalysts.confirmation: 跟踪UKMTO及Reuters后续船舶事件、相同期货合约结算和保险航运实际扰动。
catalysts.invalidation: 若可核实的油轮运输与保险风险下降、油价重新回落且升幅未持续，则通胀传导假设减弱。

catalysts.title: 美国第三季生产率改善但英国央行在11月5日加息至4%，今夜非农待验证
catalysts.evidence: BLS公布非农生产率年化+3.6%、单位劳动力成本-0.7%；英国央行投票8-1将Bank Rate提高25bp至4%，美国上周初请18.9万。
catalysts.transmission: 实际劳动市场数据→美债和美元初步定价→成长股久期及AI融资成本；英国加息是跨市场利率分叉的独立验证。
catalysts.confirmation: 11月6日21:30 SGT非农公布后核对就业、工资、修订与美债2Y/10Y同步反应。
catalysts.invalidation: 若就业报告与美债反应不匹配、英国与美国政策分歧未持续扩散，则宏观传导的重要性降低。
